_note: A path-shaped `types` entry anchors on the directory of the root config being compiled, not on the directory of whichever config in the extends chain wrote it. Under svelte-check that root is its overlay in `.svelte-check/`, so the base config's `./typedefs/amb.d.ts` does not resolve there: tsgo prints a TS2688 with no file or position, and svelte-check --tsgo 4.7.7 reports it on the project tsconfig at 1:1, quoting the entry as written. Our overlay re-anchors the entry on that same directory, so it fails the same way, and the message gets the user's spelling back.
